spans.s:
Sautra root. 10th cl. (अस्तयति)
To obscure or eclipse.

mfn. (-स्तः-स्ता-स्तं)
1 Thrown, cast.
2 Sent, dispatched.
3 Set, obscured.
4 Removed, set aside.
m. (-स्तः)
1 The western mountain, behind which the sun is supposed to set.
2 Sun-set.
n. (-स्तं)
Death, end.
E.
अस्त to obscure or eclipse, अच् affix, or अस to throw, &c. and क्त aff.

m. (-कः)
Beatitude, eternal felicity.
E.
अस्तम् disappearance, and कन् aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Set, as the sun.
E.
अस्त and गत gone.

m. (-रिः)
The western mountain.
E.
अस्त and गिरि a mountain.

mfn. (-ब्धः-ब्धा-ब्धं)
Unconfounded.
E.
अ neg. स्तब्ध astounded.

n. (-त्वं)
Self-possession, not being confused or confounded.
E.
त्व added to the last.

ind.
Disappearance, setting, vanishing.
E.
अस to send or cast, तम् aff.

f. (-ती)
A plant, (Hedysarum gangeticum): see सालपर्णी.
E.
अस्तम् the mountain, and अत to go, अच् and ङीप् affixes; abounding in the west.

n. (-नं)
Disappearance, setting.
E.
अस्तम्, अयन going.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Set, (as the sun.)
E.
अस्तम् and इत gone.

mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्)
1 Obstructed, hindered, opposed.
2 Set.
E.
अस्त thrown, &c. मतुप् poss. aff.

mfn. (-स्तः-स्ता-स्तं)
Confused, disordered, irrelevant.
E.
अस्त and व्यस्त scattered.

mfn. (-ङ्ख्यः-ङ्ख्या-ङ्ख्यं)
Innumerable.
E.
अस्त gone, सङ्ख्या number.

mfn. (-घः-घा-घं)
Very deep: see अस्थाघ.

m. (-लः)
The western mountain.
E.
अस्त, and अचल a mountain.

m. (-द्रिः)
The western mountain.
E.
अस्त, and अद्रि a mountain.

n. (-नं)
The resting of a heavenly body on the western part of the horizon.
E.
अस्त and अवलम्बन depending.

mfn. (-म्बी-म्बिनी-म्बि)
Setting as the sun, on the point of setting.
E.
अस्त and अवलम्बिन् impending.

ind.
Now being, existent, present.
E.
अस to be, and क्तिन affix, or the third person sing present tense, it is, used as a particle.

ind.
1

Doubtful.
2

Partly true and partly not.
E.
अस्ति and नास्ति it is not.

n. (-त्वं)
1 Uncertain or doubtful existence.
2 Partial existence.
E.
त्व added to the last; also अस्ति नास्तिता.

mfn. (-मान्-मती-मत्)
Wealthy, opulent.
E.
अस्ति what is, and मतुप् poss. aff.

ind.
Be it so, let it be, implying assent, also reluctance and pain.
E.
अस to be, तुम् affix or the third person sing. imperative used as a particle.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Not praised.
E.
अ neg. स्तुत praised.

n. (-नं)
Honesty.
E.
अ neg. स्तेन theft.

n. (-यं)
Honesty.
E.
अ neg. स्तेय theft.

n. (-नं)
Reproach, blame.
E.
अ deteriorative, and स्त्ये to sound, ल्युट् aff.

n. (-स्त्रं)
1 A weapon in general.
2 A sword.
3 A bow.
4 A missile weapon.
E.
अस to throw, ष्ट्रन् Uṇādi aff.

m. (-कः)
An arrow.
E.
अस्त्र and कण्ठक a thorn, a thorn-like weapon.

m. (-कः)
An armourer.
E.
अस्त्र and कारक who makes: so अस्त्रकारः and अस्त्रकारिन् m. (-री.)

m. (-कः)
A surgeon.
E.
अस्त्र and च्चिकित्सक healing; who uses instruments as means of cure.

f. (-त्सा)
Surgery.
E.
अस्त्र a knife, a lancet, and चिकित्सा healing.

m. (-वः)
A soldier, a warrior.
E.
अस्त्र a weapon, and जीव who lives by.

m. (-री)
A soldier.
E.
अस्त्र and धारिन् who bears; so अस्त्रधारक m. (-कः)

n. (-णं)
Guarding off a blow.
E.
अस्त्र and निवारण guarding.

m. (-र्ज्जः)
An armourer, a sword or tool cleaner.
E.
अस्त्र and मार्ज्ज who cleans, from मृज and अण् affix; also अस्त्रमार्ज्जक m. (-कः)

m. (-द्धः)
Fighting with weapons.
E.
अस्त्र and युद्ध battle.

f. (-द्या)
The military science.
E.
अस्त्र and विद्या knowledge.

n. (-दं)
The science of arms and war.
E.
अस्त्र a weapon, and वेद a Veda or scripture.

m. (-कः)
An iron arrow.
E.
अस्त्र, षो to destroy, वुन affix; what destroys all other weapons.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Unarmed, defenceless.
E.
अस्त्र and हीन deprived of.

m. (-रः)
An arsenal, an armoury.
E.
अस्त्र and आगार house.

m. (-तः)
A wound, a cut.
E.
अस्त्र and आघात a blow.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Struck, wounded, killed.
E.
अस्त्र and आहत struck.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
Having no female.
E.
अ neg. स्त्री female, कन् added.

m. (-रः)
1 A covering, a coverlet, a blanket thrown over the back of a horse or elephant.
2 Spreading clothes, &c.
3 A carpet, a bed.
E.
आङ्, स्तृञ् to spread, and अप् aff.

n. (-णं)
1 A carpet, a rug, a quilt, bed clothes.
2 A bed.
3 A layer of sacred grass spread out at a sacrifice.
4 An elephant's housings, a painted cloth or blanket worn on his back.
E.
as the preceding, affix ल्युट्.

m. (-कः)
The name of a Muni or saint.
E.
अस्ति who is, and वुञ् affix; from an expression of his father, (he is in the womb,) pronouncing his conception to have taken place before there were any external indications of it.
mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
A believer, pious, faithful.
E.
अस्ति as before, saying that there is a GOD, &c. in opposition to the नास्तिक an atheist, and ठक् aff.

m. (-कः)
The name of a Muni or saint, the son of JARATKĀRU, also a Muni: see आस्तिक.
E.
अस्ति and ठक् aff.

f. (-ता)
Belief in GOD.
E.
आस्तिक and तल् affix; also with त्व affix आस्तिकत्वं.

m. (-दः)
A name of a king, also called JANAMEJAYA.
E.
आस्तिक the Muni, अर्थ a request, and द who gives or grants; having at his request spared the Nāga, TAKṢAKA, from the destruction to which he had devoted the race.

f. (-नी)
The wife of JARATKĀRU, a saint.
E.
आस्तीक as above, and जननी a mother, the mother of that saint.

n. (-क्यं)
Belief in Providence and a future world.
E.
आस्तिक a believer, and यञ् aff.

mfn. (-र्णः-र्णा-र्णं)
Spread, strewed, scattered.
E.
आङ् before स्तॄ to spread, क्त aff.

Spread.
2

Covered.
E.
आङ् before स्तृ to spread, affix क्त.
